title: fix(app-shell): the dashboard preview canvas and the flow Debug run read the designer locale (objectui#10835)
body:
Fixes #10835
Clause-②: no — the locale is passed and rows are added; each en row equals today's literal, and no declared surface or stored value moves.
Supersedes PR objectui#10845 (closed by the seat): that branch carried a commit with a model-identifier trailer, and objectui squash-merges carry commit co-author trailers to main.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM (claim `5859105327`, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), implemented on `claude/issue-10835-designer-locale-v2` as one commit, `57e0689b5e`, on `main` `256b4c9ef5`. It carries the objectui#10832 review follow-up.

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.

- **`previews/DashboardPreview.tsx`.** The empty-canvas message, the `PreviewErrorBoundary` hint, the Suspense loading text, and the `SelectedWidgetStrip` words ("Selected", the "Click to rename" tooltip, the "untitled" fallback, and the "Save title", "Rename widget" and "Clear selection" aria-labels) read nine new `engine.dashboardPreview.*` rows. `SelectedWidgetStrip` takes the preview's `locale`.
- **`previews/simulator/flow-simulator.ts`.** Every note and error sentence a step records reads a new `engine.flowSim.note.*` row, through one private `say(key, vars)` helper. It is written in the locale the constructor already took for `validateFlowDraft`.
- **`previews/FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx`.** The step status chip reads `engine.flowSim.stepStatus.*` (five values), and an out-edge's `error` result reads `engine.flowSim.edge.error`.
- **`previews/screen-spec.ts` (bounded in-place fix, see H2).** `unevaluableVisibleWhen(node, locale?)` passes an optional trailing locale on to `screenVisibleWhenScopeError`, the shape that function already has. With no locale, it reads the en rows.
- **`i18n.ts`.** 48 new en rows, each the literal it replaces, and 48 zh rows beside them. No existing row moves.
- **`inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10804.test.tsx` (the objectui#10832 review follow-up).** The `engine.flowRef.notAScreenField*` en controls now read `tFormat(key, 'en-US', …)` instead of pinning the sentence. The file header says so.
- One changeset, `.changeset/10835-dashboard-preview-debug-run-locale.md` (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`). After the contract review of PR objectui#10845, its second bullet reads "every note and error sentence the simulator itself writes on a step", and its last paragraph names what stays English under zh-CN: the frames `flow-sim-validate` puts around a CEL refusal, and the default edge's `else` keyword. The frontmatter is byte-identical (md5 of the first three lines `4e8ce55021fe3b14329c8b4cb3f9f354` before and after the edit).

## Carried over from PR objectui#10845

- The change is PR objectui#10845's diff (`git diff origin/main...73fd1ccb4a`), applied with `git apply --3way`. All eight files applied cleanly; nothing was resolved by hand.
- Apart from the changeset, nothing in the eight paths differs from `73fd1ccb4a`: `git diff 73fd1ccb4a HEAD` over those paths lists only the changeset (2 insertions, 2 deletions).
- The rest of `git diff 73fd1ccb4a HEAD`, with the changeset excluded, is `main`'s own newer commits: its 30 files equal the list of `git diff 8eaa1a0022 256b4c9ef5`, and the two diffs are byte-identical (md5 `df4b7ef4f32c7d045f3a7aebb9ad01ef` for both).
- `git diff origin/main --stat` (with `origin/main` at `256b4c9ef5`): 8 files changed, 745 insertions(+), 60 deletions(-).
- `git log origin/main..HEAD` is one commit, `57e0689b5e5080d5a3635769dbafda167a288051`. It ends with the model-free pair (`Claude-Session:` and `Co-Authored-By: Claude`), and a search of the message for a model identifier finds none.

## H1 — reproduced on the base, under zh-CN, through the real components

This is the red run of the new pins. The component sources are at the base (`256b4c9ef5`, where the four component files are the same blobs as at PR objectui#10845's base `8eaa1a0022`), and the rows and pins are at HEAD. `DashboardPreview` and `FlowSimulatorPanel` were mounted with locale `zh-CN` under the i18n provider. The text below is quoted from the failure diffs.

- `DashboardPreview`:
  - the empty canvas: "Add at least one widget to see a preview."
  - the error-boundary hint: "A widget references an object or field that doesn't resolve."
  - loading: "Loading dashboard renderer…"
  - the strip: chip "Selected", tooltip "Click to rename", aria-labels "Rename widget" and "Clear selection"
  - while renaming: "Save title" and "Clear selection"
  - an empty title: "untitled"
- The Debug run:
  - a wait node: status "paused", note "Wait reached — continue manually."
  - a screen with inputs: "Screen reached — provide inputs, then continue."
  - a screen with no input: "Screen has no input — passed through (matches runtime)." and then "Flow end reached."
  - a screen whose `reason` field has `visibleWhen: 'needsApproval == true'`: "A screen field's visibleWhen may reference only the fields declared on this screen; the screen cannot evaluate "reason" (`needsApproval` is not a field on this screen)." The inner reason was English as well, because `unevaluableVisibleWhen` passed no locale.
  - one run through the other notes: "Kept as written, not modelled by the Debug run: {NOW()} in "when". …", "Mocked get record (no backend call).", "Branch "big" matched (config.conditions).", "Loop simulated as a single pass …", "Parallel split — …", ""subflow" is not modelled by the simulator; …", "Mocked call to 'notifyOwner' (no function executed)."
  - an approval: "Approval reached — choose a decision to continue.", then "Decision: approve → end."
  - a false guard: "No out-edge was taken: no guard was true and there is no default edge. …"
  - every step status chip read "ok", "paused", "mocked", "skipped" or "error", and an unparsable guard's edge result read "error".
- Lit controls, green on the base on the same mounts: the add-widget trigger (添加组件), the Debug run's Run button (运行) and the Timeline heading (时间线).

## H2 — the simulator's locale seam

- **The seam already existed.** `FlowSimulatorPanel` builds `new FlowSimulator(nodes, edges, locale)` from its `locale` prop. `FlowPreview` passes the preview's `locale`, which `ResourceEditPage` reads from `useMetadataLocale()`. The constructor stored it for `validateFlowDraft`, but none of the step sentences read it.
- **Chosen: the simulator writes its sentences in `this.locale`.** The alternative, notes emitted as keys and parameters for the panel to render, was rejected because it changes the `SimStep` shape. `note` and `error` stay `string`, so no reader moves. Every reader of `note`:
  - `FlowSimulatorPanel` renders `s.note` (and `s.error`).
  - `ScreenPreview.debugRunScope-10743.test.tsx` checks that the step's `note` names no hidden field.
  - `flow-simulator.parity-10692.test.ts` reads it seven times: "No out-edge was taken", "first declared branch", "No out-edge carries the branch label "default"", `in "out"`, `{NOW()} in "when"`, and "Kept as written" absent.
  - `flow-simulator.test.ts` reads it twice: "No out-edge was taken", and `/not modelled/i`.
  - `flow-simulator.test.ts` also reads `sim.state.error` for `/step limit/i`.
  - All of these build the simulator with no locale, so they read the en rows. They pass unchanged (see Gates).
- **The screen step's reason.** `unevaluableVisibleWhen` called `screenVisibleWhenScopeError(visibleWhen, node)` with no locale, so the `engine.flowRef.notAScreenField*` reason inside the zh frame stayed English. The locale is now passed through.
  - This is a bounded in-place fix in `screen-spec.ts`, which is outside the claim's file surface. All four conditions hold: it is the same defect class (a caller passing no locale); it is mechanical, with the optional trailing-locale shape that objectui#10832 established; no open PR touches the file (see Serial); and it runs the same gates.
  - The simulator is the only production caller. The `ScreenPreview.test.tsx` callers pass no locale and still read en.
- **Producer text passes through unchanged.** A parse or shape refusal (`@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/spec`) inside a reason, a guard error or an envelope error is the producer's own words. objectstack-ai/objectstack#20291 is not addressed here.

## H3 — census of the three files

**`flow-simulator.ts`: display, localized (33 rows).**
- Run and step errors: the step limit and node-not-found.
- Resuming and approvals: resumed, decision taken or none taken, and no decision supplied.
- Reaching a node: flow end, unsupported node, parallel split, approval, wait, screen reached, and screen with no input.
- The screen scope frame and its per-field item.
- Pass-through and decisions: pass-through, a decision with no out-edge, a branch matched, and no condition matched.
- Assignments: no assignments, an unmodelled token, and the unmodelled note.
- Loops: single pass, a collection's item count, and not an array.
- Mocks and retirements: mocked call, retired action, retired script, and mocked side effect.
- Routing: no branch label, evaluation failed, multiple matches, and no edge taken.

The step-limit sentence goes to `state.error`, which no renderer reads today; only a test does. It is localized because that same field already carries the localized `validateFlowDraft` message.

**`flow-simulator.ts`: left as written.**
- The `config.conditions[K].expression: …`, `assignments.KEY: …` and `CONDITION: …` frames are a config path or CEL source followed by a reason. They contain no words of their own.
- `DEFAULT_BRANCH_LABEL` (`default`) is the runtime's branch value, matched against author edge labels.
- The `' '`, `', '` and `'; '` separators are punctuation.

**`FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx`: display, localized.**
- The step status chip (five values) and the out-edge `error` result.
- Every other panel word already read a row.

**`FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx`: left as written.**
- A guard's `true` / `false` is its CEL value, printed on the row's code line beside the condition.
- `else` is the default edge's keyword on that code line. The canvas prints the same `else`, and the zh edge inspector keeps it (默认分支(else)).
- `→ TARGET` is a node id.
- `s.type` and the mock list's type are the stored node `type` id.
- The `{ "OUTPUT": … }` placeholder is a JSON sample.
- `=`, `▶`, `·` and `→` are symbols.
- Labels and branch names are author data.

**`DashboardPreview.tsx`: display, localized (9 rows).** These are the ones listed under What changed.

**`DashboardPreview.tsx`: left as written.**
- The `New TYPE` and `New widget` default titles are stored author data, per the objectui#10678 / objectui#10651 ruling. They are pinned as a control.
- The widget's `title` is author data.
- The `PreviewShell` `hint` strings (`dashboard · N widgets · design`) are not user-visible: `PreviewShell` no longer renders `hint`, as its own doc comment says.

## Pins and ablation

The new pin file is `previews/previewStrings.i18n-10835.test.tsx`. It uses the objectui#10696 / objectui#10748 / objectui#10804 harness: it reads the rendered text of the real `DashboardPreview` and `FlowSimulatorPanel`, reads zh back from the catalogue and guards it with `zhRow`, and reads en through `t` / `tFormat` for `en-US`. `DashboardRenderer` is a stand-in that can suspend or throw, which is how the loading text and the boundary hint are shown.

- There are 30 cases:
  - 14 zh site cases: 6 on the dashboard, 4 on the Debug run's named sites, and 4 more on the Debug run (the sweep, approval, false guard and guard error);
  - 14 en controls;
  - 2 stored-title controls, zh and en: adding a bar chart from the canvas writes `type: 'bar'` and `title: 'New bar chart'`.
- **Base component sources** (`256b4c9ef5` for `DashboardPreview.tsx`, `FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx`, `flow-simulator.ts` and `screen-spec.ts`; rows and pins at HEAD; restored by a trap, with blob == HEAD for each path and `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes after): `Tests 14 failed | 16 passed (30)`.
  - The 14 failures are exactly the zh site cases.
  - Every en control passed on the base sources, so each exercised en row renders exactly what the base literal rendered.
  - A separate check matched all 48 new en rows against the base literals they replace, with each `{name}` standing where the base interpolated: `rows=48 matched=48`.
- **Head** (`57e0689b5e`): `Tests 30 passed (30)`. The run together with the objectui#10804 file reads `Tests 51 passed (51)`.
- **Ablation** through `ablation-replace.mjs`, on `57e0689b5e`: the simulator seam `this.locale = locale;` became `this.locale = undefined;`.
  - The anchor went x1 → x0, and the blob went `3b72e31939` → `5e59861f56`.
  - Result: `Tests 7 failed | 23 passed (30)`. The 7 failures are exactly the Debug run's zh cases that read a simulator note.
  - The dashboard pins, the en controls, the stored-title controls and the guard-error case stayed green. The guard-error case reads only the panel's own status and edge rows.
  - Restored: blob == HEAD (`3b72e31939`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - The pins import the source by relative path, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the run.

## Gates

Every line below was run on HEAD `57e0689b5e`.

- **Related suites:**
  - the 20 test files that import `DashboardPreview`, `FlowSimulatorPanel`, `flow-simulator`, `screen-spec` or `FlowPreview`;
  - `block-config-i18n.test.ts` and `perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx`, which read the designer table;
  - result: `Test Files 22 passed (22) · Tests 358 passed (358)`.
- The i18n gate scripts' own suites (`check-i18n-dead-keys`, `check-i18n-designer-table-parity`, `check-i18n-en-drift`): `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 211 passed (211)`.
- **Declared narrowing.** The full `packages/app-shell` suite is left to CI.
- **Type check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 28/28 tasks). `--listFiles` shows that `tsconfig.test.json` compiles both pin files.
- **eslint on the 7 changed source and test files.**
  - Every file is inside eslint's config (`--print-config` exits 0 for each).
  - `--format json`: 7 files, 0 errors, 8 warnings, all in `DashboardPreview.tsx`. The base file has the same 8 (`exhaustive-deps` ×3, `no-explicit-any` ×4, `set-state-in-effect`), on lines this diff only shifts.
  - No type-aware linting is configured (no `parserOptions` / `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`), and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads the disk. So this diff cannot move any verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide lint is CI's.
- The remaining gates:
  - `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0: "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."
  - `check:i18n-drift` 0: "No designer-table en value changed in this range."
  - `check:i18n-keys` 0 and `check:designer-field-key-parity` 0.
  - `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new).
  - `check:control-bytes` 0.
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0.
  - `check:test-path-roots` 0 and `check:unreferenced-sources` 0.
  - `check:changeset-claims` 0 and `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0.
  - `check-changeset-presence` 0 and `check-changeset-no-major` 0.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED (8 paths).
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only. It lists no new row as a candidate. The five `engine.flowSim.stepStatus.*` rows are held live by their template head in `FlowSimulatorPanel`.

## Serial

- `git merge-tree --write-tree` against a freshly fetched `main` `ed76b1b08a` is clean (tree `d1026096e5`). No `metadata-admin/` file changed on `main` between the base `256b4c9ef5` and `ed76b1b08a`.
- Open PRs at 20:26Z: none of the 11 non-release PRs other than the superseded PR objectui#10845 touches any file in this diff, including objectui#10821.
- The release PR objectui#5400 has 1732 files. Its first 400 files show no overlap, and the remaining 1332 were not read.

## Acceptance notes

These designer surfaces are still English under zh-CN. They are outside this card's file surface. They were found in passing through a zh probe of the same mounts; this is not a sweep.

- **`previews/PreviewShell.tsx`, `PreviewErrorBoundary`.** Its heading "Preview failed to render" sits above the now-zh hint on every preview's error boundary. The probe read: 添加组件Preview failed to render…某个组件引用了无法解析的对象或字段。
- **`previews/ScreenPreview.tsx`, inside the Debug run's paused screen.** The "Preview" header, the "Submit" button, and the empty text "Add a title, description, fields, or an object form to preview this screen."
- **`previews/simulator/flow-sim-validate.ts`.** Its own frames around producer text in a step's or out-edge's error: "CEL evaluation failed: ", "condition failed to evaluate as CEL: ", and the fallback "Evaluation failed.". The probe read: `discount > 1: condition failed to evaluate as CEL: Unknown variable: discount`.
- **`previews/FlowCanvas.tsx`.** Its default-edge label `else` and `if CONDITION` are left for the same reason as the panel's `else`: they are keywords on a code line. This is not a defect claim.
- **`inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10804.test.tsx`.** Its other en controls ("Screen fields" and the widget-picker words) still pin literal wording. The review follow-up named only the `engine.flowRef.notAScreenField*` controls, so they were left as they are.
